description: CTO FROZEN INCIDENTS §A: add an EVIDENCE-BASED OBSOLETE transition for self-diagnostic incidents whose mission has NO executable contract on disk (so they can never be revalidated by the normal pipeline). Distinct from RESOLVED. NON-DESTRUCTIVE (history preserved). FORBIDDEN to mark OBSOLETE any incident whose contract EXISTS, to invent a resolution, or to delete an incident. incident-recurrence excludes OBSOLETE (like RESOLVED) from the active verdict. Both ports.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO FROZEN INCIDENTS: EVIDENCE-BASED CLOSURE §A (policy decision authorizing an evidence-based OBSOLETE transition for absent-contract incidents).

work_item_contract.objective: missionContractExists(mission) (fs check of runtime/missions/<mission>.json) + resolveObsoleteIncidents(opts): transition OPEN/FROZEN incidents whose mission contract is ABSENT → OBSOLETE (obsoletedAt + obsoletedReason, record preserved). incident-recurrence excludes OBSOLETE from verdict/counts (surfaced as summary.obsolete).
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: EVIDENCE: 3 FROZEN incidents reference missions with NO runtime/missions/<mission>.json (M, NL_IMPLEMENT_E4DDB6BA, 'Proof slash a/b (paren)…') ⇒ the evidence-gated resolution lifecycle (which needs a fresh same-mission diagnose) can NEVER clear them ⇒ permanent false FROZEN_LOOP contribution. ROOT CAUSE: no lifecycle state for 'mission gone'. PLAN: add an OBSOLETE transition gated on the OBJECTIVE fact that the contract file is absent.
work_item_contract.scope: self-diagnostic (both ports): missionContractExists + resolveObsoleteIncidents + export. incident-recurrence (both ports): exclude OBSOLETE. One new hermetic test. No change to diagnose's divergence detection, verdict authority, repair routing, RESOLVED lifecycle, or loop-protection.
invariants: EVIDENCE-GATED: OBSOLETE ONLY when runtime/missions/<mission>.json is ABSENT. An incident whose contract EXISTS is NEVER obsoleted (hard guard).
NON-DESTRUCTIVE: status transition only (OPEN/FROZEN→OBSOLETE) preserving id/attempts/createdAt/divergences/hypotheses; adds obsoletedAt+obsoletedReason. No deletion.
Distinct states OPEN/FROZEN/RESOLVED/OBSOLETE preserved; a RESOLVED or already-OBSOLETE incident is not re-transitioned.
Anti-false-success intact: OBSOLETE is NOT a success/validation; it is 'unrevalidatable, mission gone'.
acceptance_criteria: Hermetic test (isolated temp cwd): absent-contract FROZEN ⇒ OBSOLETE; present-contract FROZEN ⇒ UNCHANGED (forbidden transition guarded); RESOLVED/OBSOLETE not re-transitioned; history (id/createdAt/divergences) preserved; incident-recurrence excludes OBSOLETE (verdict drops, summary.obsolete surfaced); dual-port parity. Non-regression self-diagnostic/cycle/ranking/incident-recurrence/incident-resolution ALL PASS. tsc 0. Applied LIVE to the real ledger ⇒ exactly the 3 absent-contract incidents become OBSOLETE; __none__ (contract exists) stays FROZEN. Diff limited to write-set; committed.
stop_conditions: Any incident with an existing contract would be obsoleted; a forbidden transition cannot be guarded; a path outside the write-set is needed.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- runtime/core/self-diagnostic.{js,ts} runtime/core/incident-recurrence.{js,ts} ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; rm -f runtime/core/incident-obsolete.test.ts runtime/missions/INCIDENT_OBSOLETE_TRANSITION.json; npm run build:runtime.
evidence_required: live ledger: exactly 3 OBSOLETE, __none__ stays FROZEN

objectives.goal: Evidence-gated OBSOLETE transition for absent-contract incidents; existing-contract never obsoleted; non-destructive; recurrence excludes OBSOLETE; both ports; proven hermetic + live.
done_when: All acceptance_criteria met; committed in write-set.

definition_of_done: self-diagnostic can mark an incident OBSOLETE only on the objective evidence that its mission contract is absent; existing-contract incidents never obsoleted; history preserved; recurrence excludes OBSOLETE; both ports; committed (no force). A truth-of-status reliability improvement, NOT an artificial resolution.
